relations.statement: If a matrix G is invariant under a transitive set of permutations S, then its diagonal entries are constant on the whole index set.
relations.hypotheses: G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ, S : Set (Equiv.Perm (Fin n)), hS : ∀ σ ∈ S, InnerProductFable.SectorForm.Invariant G σ, hT : InnerProductFable.SectorForm.TransitiveOn S

lemmas.statement: Transitive sector symmetry of the quadratic readout holds: relabelling sectors by any permutation from a transitive group leaves the readout unchanged.
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
theorem transitive_sector_symmetry_law {G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℚ} {S : Set (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))}
  (hS : ∀ σ ∈ S, InnerProductFable.SectorForm.Invariant G σ)
  (hT : InnerProductFable.SectorForm.TransitiveOn S) :
  ∀ i j, G i i = G j j :=
by
  exact InnerProductFable.SectorForm.diag_const_of_transitive hS hT

open_obligations: Provide a formal definition of the quadratic readout as a sesquilinear form on sector vectors.
Show that the invariant property used in rel_diag_const_of_transitive matches the notion of readout invariance required by the target.
